* feat: keep vicinae open on close browser tab by @Keyruu in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2043
* feat(api): expose BrowserExtension.closeTab to extensions by @Keyruu in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2044
* feat(i18n): polish language support by @AdrianKokot in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2052
* feat(browser): expose tab metadata by @Keyruu in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2053
* fix(file-chooser): use "Select" labels for file and directory pickers by @maxxxbond in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2041
* feat(extensions): enable marking an item as active by @Keyruu in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2060
* fix(macOS): read app Info.plist without NSBundle's per-path cache by @Meldiron in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2068
* fix(install): repair directory permissions from the AppImage by @markmandel in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2056
* feat(clipboard): save as action by @aurelleb in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2081
* feat(api): add isLoading prop to Detail by @Hash-AK in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2080
* fix(lint): address qmllint issues by @aurelleb in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2083
* feat(clipboard): open and edit selections by @aurelleb in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2082
* fix(nix): only override numen stdenv with gcc15 on linux by @Keyruu in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2075
* fix(i18n): move Q_DECLARE_TR_FUNCTIONS to the top of declared struct by @AdrianKokot in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2076
* feat(windows): add keyboard binding preference for "run as administration" action by @AdrianKokot in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2078
* feat(calculator): more human readable datetime formatting by @sur4y in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2087
* feat(macOS): remove libqalculate support by @aurelleb in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2090
* fix(api): map CopyName/CopyPath/CopyDeeplink to their own shortcuts by @Hash-AK in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2096
* fix(i18n): fix typos in Italian Escape strings by @fraluc06 in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2099
* fix(clipboard): preserve rich text offers when copying from history by @markmandel in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2094
* feat(linux): dual-stroke window border by @aurelleb in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2098

## New Contributors
* @AdrianKokot made their first contribution in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2052
* @Hash-AK made their first contribution in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2080
* @sur4y made their first contribution in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2087
* @fraluc06 made their first contribution in https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/pull/2099

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/vicinaehq/vicinae/compare/v0.29.1...v0.29.2
